name: rms-norm-pk
title: rms_norm: block-reduction row kernel via real MLIR toolchain, PK liger head-to-head
creator: kingdom
notes: DONE. First real PK of the campaign. MLIR-generated read-once block-cooperative row kernel (one gpu.launch/row, T=num_warps*32 mirroring liger calculate_settings, per-thread alloca caches x once, gpu.all_reduce sum-of-squares fp32, rstd via NVVM rsqrt.approx intrinsic since math.sqrt/rsqrt are libdevice dead-ends, 2nd pass writes y from cache) lowered by the REAL toolchain (mlir-opt->nvvm->ptxas->sm_120a). Kernel-only PK vs REAL liger _rms_norm_forward_kernel: PARITY (1.032x @(32768,1024), 1.000x @(16384,4096); both ~340-365 GB/s). Bit-faithful rel ~1e-7 vs fp32 ref AND liger (Y+RSTD) incl non-pow2 tail-mask. Parity IS the win (memory-bound, identical 128-thread geometry); no win claimed (0.77x probe was a transient-clock artifact, retracted). v4 vectorization lowers (ld.global.v4) but no gain (HBM-bound) -> scalar retained. Gates passed: gpu.all_reduce block reduction lowers to sm_120a + correct; real liger installed/runnable (rms_norm_forward, bypassing the crashing autograd Function). test_rmsnorm_pk 3 passed.
